title: Spinor inequality for magnetic fields on spin manifolds
summary: This paper is concerned with the zero mode equation $D_g\varphi=iA\cdot\varphi$ on closed spin manifold $(M^n,g,σ)$ of positive scalar curvature. Here $A$ is a real one form on $M$. We proved that if $(\varphi, A)$ is a non trivial solution of the zero mode equation then $$\parallel dA\parallel_{n/2}>Y(M^n,[g])/(4v_n^{1/2}),$$ where $Y(M^n,[g])$ is the Yamabe constant of $(M^n,g)$ and $v_n=\left[\frac{n}{2}\right]$. In the case of the round sphere $(\mathbb{S}^n,g_{can},σ_{can})$ this result confirms that the inequality obtained in \cite{Frank} is not sharp.
